charts.question: One-year-ahead cash-flow forecasts
charts.supported_finding: Each fitted model sees only labels publicly filed before the forecast.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Predictive associations in a selected panel do not establish manipulation or causality. Vendor non-trade receivables are distinct from customer trade balances. Scenario valuations depend on payout, opening book, abnormal-return persistence and cost of equity.
